description: Default FAKE SDK review (#312): looks at dev-context and answers one verdict for every open issue of the GitHub stand-in's organisation acme (infra/e2e/notification-receiver/GitHubStandIn.Project.cs and GitHubStandIn.Review.cs). No model runs. The phase keeps only the verdicts for the issues of its batch, as it must for a real model's answer too, and answers an issue of the batch this script does not name as unsure with low confidence. scripts/e2e/ui/tests/planner-review.spec.ts reads this file for what to expect; change both together.
